blocks.text: Wide Area Network (WAN) bara geographic area (zameen ka bara ilaqa) cover karta hai (jaise Figure 1.4 mein). Yeh mukhtalif shehron ya mulkon ke networks ko jorta hai. WAN leased lines (company se kiraye par li gayi khaas lines), satellites ya Internet istemal karta hai. Is mein data transfer speed LAN se kam hoti hai. WAN lagana aur manage karna (chalana) mehnga hai. Internet WAN ki sab se bari misaal hai.

blocks.alt: WAN ka nishan; Internet likhe teen badal tooti lakeeron se jure hain, aur har badal aik jagah ke Wi-Fi router se jura hai: computers aur phone wale do ghar, aur desktop computer wali daftar ki imarat.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.4: Wide Area Network (WAN) (kitab ki Figure 1.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kisi bank ki Lahore, Karachi aur Islamabad ki branches ke LANs ko aapas mein jorne wala network WAN hai.

blocks.prompt: LAN aur WAN mein do farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: WAN shehron ya mulkon jaisa bara ilaqa cover karta hai, LAN chhota ilaqa. WAN ki raftar LAN se kam hai aur WAN lagana aur chalana mehnga hai.

items: WAN: shehar ya mulk; leased lines, satellites ya Internet; LAN se aahista aur mehnga; sab se bara WAN = Internet.
